why: These twelve families were merged into one product each with a Colour option, then split back out. Each entry recreates the products the catalogue had before the merge: one product per finish, with its own handle, price, SKU, stock and photographs. The site groups them by title (lib/product-family.ts) and the swatch row links between them.
sourceOfTruth: Captured from the live store before the merge. Images are Shopify Files that still exist; look each one up by filename rather than by a versioned URL.
